ears_visibility.value: "El rostro y orejas del usuario deben estar 100% descubiertos" — the user's face and ears must be 100% uncovered

face_visibility.value: "El cabello no debe cubrir las orejas ni la totalidad de la frente" — hair must not cover the ears nor the entirety of the forehead

headwear_policy.value: "Tampoco podrán usar sombreros o cintillos que cubran el rostro" — hats or headbands that cover the face are not permitted

accessories.value: "Los aretes en las mujeres no podrán exceder el 20% del tamaño de la oreja" — earrings worn by women must not exceed 20% of the size of the ear

expression_restriction.value: "Los ojos deben estar abiertos moderadamente" — eyes must be moderately open

file_spec.value: For domestic first-time/renewal passport procedures, applicants do NOT need to bring a photo — fingerprints, photo, and signature are captured on-site at Registro Civil agencies ("Para el trámite de pasaportes NO NECESITA TRAER FOTOS. Se procederá con captura de huellas dactilares, toma de foto y de firma en el área de pasaportes directamente en las agencias del Registro Civil")

ears_visibility.en: The applicant's face and ears must be 100% uncovered.
ears_visibility.ko: 얼굴과 귀가 100% 드러나야 함(가림 없이 노출).
ears_visibility.ja: 顔と耳は100%露出していること(隠れていないこと)。

face_visibility.en: Hair must not cover the ears or the entirety of the forehead.
face_visibility.ko: 머리카락이 귀나 이마 전체를 가려서는 안 됨.
face_visibility.ja: 髪の毛で耳や額全体を覆ってはならない。

headwear.en: Hats or headbands that cover the face are not permitted.
headwear.ko: 얼굴을 가리는 모자나 헤어밴드 착용 불가.
headwear.ja: 顔を覆う帽子やヘアバンドの着用は不可。

accessories.en: Earrings worn by women must not exceed 20% of the size of the ear.
accessories.ko: 여성의 귀걸이는 귀 크기의 20%를 초과할 수 없음.
accessories.ja: 女性のピアス・イヤリングは耳の大きさの20%を超えてはならない。

expression.ja: 目は適度に開いていること。

capture_model_note.note: Ecuador's Registro Civil (Civil Registry, the passport-issuing authority) captures the passport photo in-person at its own service points for domestic applicants — there is no self-prepared/self-submitted print size to verify against DB's '5×5cm' for most cases. DB's size/background/head_height values could not be confirmed or contradicted against an official self-print spec and are left unverified rather than guessed. Direct WebFetch to registrocivil.gob.ec returned HTTP 403 and to gob.ec returned a connection refusal on repeated attempts; content was confirmed via grounded web search quoting verbatim Spanish text specifically attributed to registrocivil.gob.ec (Ecuador's official Civil Registry, under the Cancillería/MREMH umbrella).
